subject.title: [Bug]: Skill Workshop agent-tool apply times out because approval wait exceeds tool watchdog

question: Should this issue be resolved by the broader approval-flow fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 after its approval-boundary blocker is addressed, or by the narrower watchdog-only fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325?
rationale: Both open PRs claim this issue but change different security and availability boundaries: one shortens/enriches Skill Workshop approvals, while the other raises only Codex `skill_workshop` watchdogs.

options.title: Land Broader Approval Flow After Security Fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical fix once lifecycle approval is bound to the displayed proposal revision and review findings are cleared.

options.title: Land Narrow Watchdog Alignment
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325 if maintainers want the smallest timeout repair and defer popup metadata and timeout semantics to separate issues.

options.title: Keep Both Paused For Approval Design
options.body: Hold this issue open if maintainers want a larger approval authority and timeout policy decision before accepting either fix shape.

recommendation.title: Land Broader Approval Flow After Security Fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical fix once lifecycle approval is bound to the displayed proposal revision and review findings are cleared.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this issue and owns the broader open closing PR that currently carries the active security-boundary decision.
